title: Real time Persona 5 Tokyo Transition screen + Weather [Customizable] [4k] by Becco38
description:
[url=https://ko-fi.com/Becco38]✨𝓢𝓾𝓹𝓹𝓸𝓻𝓽 𝓶𝓮✨[/url]

Q) How do I customize this?
A) Open wallpaper engine, on the right side panel you will see the wallpaper that you are currently using. 
On the same portion of the window, scroll all the way down to find the settings.

Q) Why is the weather not in sync with my location?
A) I know it'd be cool to see real weather sync/forecast but, as for now, 'scene' types of wallpaper (written in wallpaper engine’s own script language called ‘scenescript’) can't handle any online calls from weather APIs.
So, for the time being, it’s something you can adjust manually whenever you want for aesthetic purposes only.

Q) Why does the ‘flip’ option flip the whole image like in a mirror? (The HUD is flipped too)
A) That option was not designed by me, but by wallpaper engine developers. You can also notice that it’s in every single wallpaper in this platform.
The wallpaper is not built or designed to be flipped.

Q) My monitor is xxxx resolution by xxxx, how can I stretch the whole thing to fit in my display?
A) The wallpaper is 16:9, try to adapt it in the default user properties made by developers to fit your needs.

Q) Can you add other Persona games music?
A) No, this wallpaper is quite beefy speaking of weight/space. Any further songs that are not p5 related won’t be added.

Q) What’s the time chart?
A) This one:
Dawn: 5am to 7 am
Day: 7am to 3pm
Afternoon: 3pm to 6pm
Sunset: 6pm to 8pm
Evening/Night: 8pm to 5 am


This wallpaper features:

-Almost every P5/Royal song

-Audio Slider widget to adjust the volume

-Aficionado fansite comments (some of them are my Ko-Fi supporters)

-Persona 5 confidant music widget:
The confidants cycle automatically rolls by default, but you can manually select a static character you like.

-Heat wave and hot night for the sunny weather condition and pollen warning for the cloudy condition.
(Just make sure you check the calendar options if you want to enable them)

-Real time sync with the city

-Working Calendar Sync with inverted color scheme options like in Royal 
(Huge thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198116198827]Bvrrvcudv[/url] for the calendar scripting)

-Customizable clock - size, position, color

-Customizable Weather conditions: Sunny, Rainy, Cloudy and Snowy

-Customizable Audio Responsive Bars and Circle ripples - on/off, color change

-Audio Responsive City Lights (8pm to 5 am only) - on/off

-Customizable Xmas Lights for windows




Thank you all very much for the support and love shared through all this time. 
I must say that It really is heartwarming to read comments even several months after the release of this project.
I’m glad to make people happy with what I do, and it is a wonderful feeling that fills my days; even though it’s just a wallpaper.❤️

title: Pac-Man
description:
